name: Bulgaria
spiritual_teacher: Peter Deunov / White Brotherhood (Sacred Rila Lakes, rich esoteric heritage, regular Advaita retreats)
work_strategy: Hybrid / Remote (7.5% freelancer tax or 10% corporate tax; Temporary Protection issued in 1 day)
it_market: Medium (Large outsourcing hub in Sofia, international offices, but lower salaries than Western Europe)
ua_fop_and_local_taxes: First 183 days €0; after 183 days 27.8% social contributions on €620.20 min base (€172.42 fixed) + 7.5% eff. PIT = €200–230/mo; Single Tax not credited under DTT.

numbeo_mandatory_fields: Estimated monthly costs for a single person without rent (food, transport, basic household)
Basic utilities (Electricity, Heating, Cooling, Water, Garbage) + Internet (Broadband)

climate: Temperate maritime on the coast (Varna/Burgas), continental inland.
*Winter:* day +5...+8°C, night -2...+2°C (strong sea winds, occasional frost).
*Heating season:* 4.5–5 months (November–March). AC/radiator heating costs ~€90–140/mo (notable expense).
nature: Sea, Mountains, Coniferous forests (Black Sea — Varna/Burgas; high mountains — Rhodopes, Rila, Pirin)
english_level: Moderate (Fluent in Sofia, Varna, and IT; Bulgarian or Russian in daily life/government offices)
housing_rent: Very cheap. On the coast (Varna, Burgas, or quiet Balchik/Dobrich 80 km from Constanta) off-peak rent is ~€250–320 for a 1-bedroom; in Plovdiv ~€280–340; easy entry without lengthy background checks.
citizenship: 10 years (5 years TRP/TP + 5 years PRP, or standard naturalization)
mortgage_expats: Moderate (Banks lend to residents with official income at 2.8–3.8% APR)
rent_to_buy: Rare (Available in new coastal resort complexes via direct developer agreement)

protection_and_aid_2026.entry_documents: Biometric passport. On first exit from frontline zones, entry is possible with an old passport, ID, driver's license, or birth certificate. Exiting Bulgaria (except to Ukraine) — biometric ONLY!
protection_and_aid_2026.protection_status: Temporary Protection (Vremenna zakrila) until March 4, 2027. Issued at Ministry of Interior offices in 15 minutes.
protection_and_aid_2026.military_liable_rule_2026: **From 31.07.2026, EU countries do not grant protection to conscription-eligible men without proof of legal exit and deferment.**
protection_and_aid_2026.social_benefits: One-time social welfare grant (Social Assistance Directorate) — 375 BGN (~€190) per family (frequent denials). Red Cross aid — 125 BGN/mo per person for 3 months for vulnerable groups.
protection_and_aid_2026.housing_aid: Free hotel accommodation ended. State facilities are overcrowded; before placement, applicants go to a temporary camp in Elhovo (up to 30 days, Spartan conditions). 1-year lease requires 1–2 months deposit.
protection_and_aid_2026.healthcare: State covers mandatory health insurance (zdravna osigurovka) for the first 90 days (entire TP duration for minors and pensioners). After 90 days, €14.5/mo (28.40 BGN), paid directly to NRA. Mandatory registration with a GP (lichen lekar).
protection_and_aid_2026.transport: Free public transit for Ukrainians with TP applies ONLY in Sofia (metro and surface transport). Standard fares in other cities.
protection_and_aid_2026.work_rights: Automatic right to work without special permits. Registration at the Employment Agency.

items: [Imot.bg](https://www.imot.bg/) — #1 real estate site in Bulgaria (Varna, Burgas, Sofia, Plovdiv). Largest long-term rental database.
[Alo.bg](https://www.alo.bg/obiavi/imoti-naemi/) — huge local classifieds portal (most direct-from-owner listings).
[BulgarIMOT.bg](https://bulgarimot.bg/en/bulgaria/for-rent/) — reliable platform with detailed listings and remote assistance.
[Homes.bg](https://www.homes.bg/) — large database of current rental listings.
[OLX.bg](https://www.olx.bg/nedvizhimi-imoti/naemi/) — popular classifieds board direct from owners with no commission.
[Flatio.com](https://www.flatio.com/i/apartments-for-rent-bulgaria) — verified furnished apartments for remote work (Varna, Sofia, Bansko) with no hidden fees.
[Airbnb Monthly](https://www.airbnb.com.ua/bulgaria/stays/monthly) — discounts for 28+ day stays, utilities and Wi-Fi included (ideal for first weeks).
[Bulgarian Properties](https://www.bulgarianproperties.com/rent_properties/) — one of the largest agencies for year-round and seasonal rentals.
[BolgarskiyDom](https://ua.bolgarskiydom.com/) — specializes in foreign clients on the 1st–2nd sea lines.
**Fake listings:** Sites often have artificially low 'bait prices' from unscrupulous brokers ('already rented, but we have pricier ones'). Benchmark against market rates (~€250–320 for 1-bedroom).
**Utilities:** Electricity, water, and internet are almost never included. Winter AC heating can produce high electricity bills.
**'Taksa poddruzhka' (Maintenance fee):** In gated coastal resort complexes, always clarify upfront who pays the complex maintenance fee (pool, security, elevator) — it can be €20–50/mo.

**Facebook groups:** Many owners rent commission-free via Bulgarian queries (*'naem bez posrednik'*, *'kvartiri pod naem'*) and local expat rental groups. Never send a deposit without a signed contract.

notes: **Strict conditions:** income `€600 / €750 / €800 / €1,000/mo` net after UA FOP Group 3; >1 year horizon factoring in deferment.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.legality_over_183d_with_deferral: Covered by **EU 2026/1912** (TP until 04.03.2027); men need proof of legal exit and deferment. Without TP, Nomad/D-visa is unavailable at €600–1,000.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.social_contrib_27_8_pct: mandatory minimum for self-employed (*svobodna profesiya*) on **€620.20/mo** min base (from 01.08.2026; was €550.66 until July) = **€172.42/mo fixed** (even at €600 income).
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.pit: 10% after 25% statutory deduction (effectively **7.5%**) minus social contributions. Ukrainian 5% Single Tax is not credited.
ua_fop_tax_budget_2026.verdict: **Unprofitable at €600–800/mo** due to high fixed social contribution `€172.42/mo`; suitable only as a transit up to 183 days.
